purpose: Locate the next wall-clock bottleneck on the reviewed runtime and check the historical two-session FP16 trajectory.
conditions: Llama 3.2 3B Q4-mixed, FP16 KV, two sessions, four workers, 128/1024 tokens per session.
method: Existing stage-timing protocol interleaves four timer-off and four timer-on replays in each prefix. Report wall-time roles from timed replays and CPU samples separately. Compare IDs, logits, KV and workspace against the previous two-session receipt at both prefixes.
